description: Open-source (Apache 2.0) voice layer for Claude Code and Codex on macOS. Runs fully local with Kokoro text-to-speech, no account or API keys: hear a short spoken summary when your agent finishes, fails or needs approval. Optional ElevenLabs voices. Jarvis for your agents.
summary: Open-source voice layer for coding agents on macOS. Text-to-speech for Claude Code and Codex: hear a short spoken summary when your agent finishes, fails or needs approval. Local Kokoro or ElevenLabs. Jarvis for your agents.
